breakdown.description: The diagram uses the full charge-state set, but the competing-phase report is restricted to only the neutral and positive folders.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still restricts the competing phases report to only neutral and positive charge states [0, 1] by building a second FormationEnergyDiagram with only those charge states. The ground truth requires a single FormationEnergyDiagram built from all four charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1], with competing_phases_at_chempot_limits called on that same diagram without any charge-state restriction. The generated spec perpetuates the original error from the incomplete prompt.
